headline: PNC Financial Services Group (PNC) Stock May Trade At A Discount To Fair Value
summary: PNC Financial Services Group has delivered a 116.3% return over the past three years, yet valuation checks present a more measured picture, with the intrinsic value estimate suggesting the stock may trade below what the Excess Returns model implies. At the same time, market based multiples look roughly in line with peers, which puts more focus on whether that intrinsic value gap is durable.
